findings.explanation: mirror moon moves the scene one hour later.

findings.evidenceJa: 体はすっかり元気になった
findings.governingReading: his body has completely regained its energy
findings.explanation: A claim of full bodily vigor becomes relative improvement, obscuring the deliberate contradiction with later lingering sluggishness.

findings.explanation: At ten in the morning, mirror moon invents a full day of sweating.
